ItemID: unavailable; Title: Partners; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues and roots rock rather than vocal duets right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little information to choose it.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Very Best Of Paul Anka; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Traditional pop does not fit my current blues and rock listening mood.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Hot Rocks 1964-1971; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Stones' blues-rooted rock appeals, but I would prioritize a different album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Joe Bonamassa's guitar-driven blues feels like a strong follow-up to my recent albums; I would choose it.
